THE RULES ARE SIMPLE

A race from A to Z.

  1. Gather around a screen and spin the dials. The category settles first, then the start letter, then the end letter.
  2. Find a word beginning with the orange letter and ending with the green one, in the purple category. S + T + Nature = sunset.
  3. Shout it! The first valid word wins. Settle ties together, then spin again.

Agree your house rules first: we suggest real English words, at least two letters, and no names. Keep score out loud if you like.

Keep a favourite

Use the lock button above any dial to hold its result while the others spin. Unlock at least one dial to play. Friendly mode finds a word that fits the locks; if none is in our list, unlock a dial or choose All letters.

Make it your game

Friendly pairs always have an example word in the chosen category. All letters can give you impossible combinations — just spin again. Switch on the 30-second timer for a little pressure.

Take it offline

Open this game online once and wait for “Offline ready”. Then you can reopen it without a connection. Add it to your home screen from your browser’s menu for easy access.
